spans.s:
kapaṭa-prabandha, m. continued series
of frauds; machination, plot.

kaparda, m. small shell used as a coin,
80 = 1paṇa; -aka, m. the same.

kapā́la, n.
 —1. cup or dish, 102^13;
 —2.
cover or lid, 104^16;
 —3. cranium. [for
mg, cf. Lat. testa, ‘earthen pot,’ w. French
tête, ‘head.’]

kā-puruṣa, m. miserable man, coward.
[see 1ká 4, and 506.]
